title: Oct 13 Results + Oct 14 Preview: Let's Talk About That Disaster
summary: Oct 13 was a humbling 0-1 nightmare. Time to rebound with Dodgers on Oct 14.

content.value:
## Let Me Be Honest: That Was Embarrassing

Okay, let's not sugarcoat this—October 13 was an absolute trainwreck. We went 0-1. Zero wins. One loss. A perfect storm of getting it completely wrong. The Guardians were supposed to show up against the Rays, and instead they laid an egg so spectacular it belongs in a museum of failures.

But here's the thing nobody wants to hear: sometimes you swing and miss. Sometimes the model gets humbled. And you know what? I'm not going to make excuses. We picked Cleveland at 50%, they lost, and now we move on. That's baseball, baby.

## The Guardians-Rays Autopsy

A 50% confidence pick? That should've been our first warning sign. When you're essentially flipping a coin, don't be shocked when it lands on tails. The Guardians couldn't generate offense, and the Rays—bless them—actually showed up to play baseball. Revolutionary concept, I know.

The brutal truth? We had no business being confident in that game, and the results prove it. One game, one miss, and a harsh reminder that October baseball is an entirely different beast.

## Oct 14 Preview: Redemption Time With The Dodgers

Now let's talk about tomorrow, because dwelling on yesterday is for losers. We've got Brewers traveling to Los Angeles to face the Dodgers, and if you're not paying attention to this pitching matchup, you're sleeping at the wheel.

Robert Gasser for Milwaukee against Blake Snell for LA. On paper, this shouldn't even be close. Snell—when he's locked in—is an absolute nightmare for opposing lineups. The Dodgers at home in October? That's the kind of advantage that makes Vegas smile.

content.title: ⭐ Tomorrow's Top Pick
content.sub: 57% win probability · Snell vs Gasser · Home field dominance

content.value:
## Why The Dodgers Will Bounce Us Back

Let me be provocative here: 57% confidence might actually be too conservative. The Dodgers have the better pitcher, the better lineup, and home field advantage in a playoff atmosphere. Gasser is talented, sure, but he's walking into a buzzsaw.

The Milwaukee offense has been inconsistent, and asking them to solve Blake Snell in Dodger Stadium during October? Good luck with that. LA smells blood in the water, and they're going to feast.

We're riding with the Dodgers tomorrow, and I'm not apologizing for it. After the Guardians debacle, we need a statement win. This is it.

## The Bottom Line

Oct 13 stung. It should sting. But that's why we preview tomorrow—because one bad day doesn't define a season, and it certainly doesn't shake our process. The Dodgers are the play on Oct 14, and if you disagree, well, that's what makes this fun.

Let's get that win back. See you tomorrow when we watch LA do exactly what we expect them to do.

—Rico
